text:
alyssa: Quick heads up — OrionHealth (clinical analytics) just told CS they have 3 new squads onboarding this quarter and want embeddings + real-time summarization. They ran a staging load and saw ~3x QPS compared to our pilot. Renewal in ~10 weeks. Immediate asks: dedicated pilot capacity, PHI/VPC guidance, and committed pricing options. CC @mike @raj @sara

mike: Got it. Do they plan to stream summaries or batch? any PII in the input? also need sample request traces + seq length distribution to size pods.

alyssa: They want streaming for summaries (low latency). Inputs include de‑identified PHI now but legal expects ability to onboard PHI in future — they asked about VPC/private later. I'll request a 24h replay + a small set of sanitized traces.

raj: Engineering note: initial dedicated pilot we can allocate a 2xA100 pod (or equivalent Ampere/AMD) for trial. Need traffic profile: tokens/sec, avg seq len, streaming usage, percent of embeddings vs generation. Alyssa can you get a sample payload and `curl` logs? Example we need: 
```
POST /v1/generate 
{
  "model": "rwd-compat-1.3",
  "input": "...",
  "stream": true
}
```

sara: For enablement i'll fast-track a streaming+tool-calling SDK example and a slide deck with best practices for caching/quantization tradeoffs. Also capture product feedback: they asked for a per-team capacity reservation UI and per-route token cost breakdown in the console. Adding to backlog as a request.

ellie: I'll lead the renewal convo — price predictability is the main risk they called out. They mentioned exploring direct cloud endpoints from vendors if we can't show committed cost savings. We should prepare a clear committed vs on-demand pricing slide + SLA expectations.

mike: Also they'll need KMS/HSM notes for PHI and SOC/TSP docs. I'll attach our compliance packet draft.

alyssa: Capturing feature asks from the call: 
- team-level capacity reservations (reserve throughput per team)
- console view: per-route token & latency breakdown by model
- quickstart for streaming + tool calls (SDK snippet)

raj: Implementation thoughts: team-level reservations likely need quota + scheduler changes; initial work could be a soft reservation layer that maps teams to isolated pods. Will estimate after we see sample traffic.

sara: Product ask: can we surface a "trial committed" option to show cost delta when customers toggle caching/quantization? That would directly address their procurement concern.

alyssa: Meeting scheduled with OrionHealth on Wed 2pm to walk pilot options and pricing. Need slides + engineering sizing by Tue EOD. Who can help with sizing and compliance notes? @mike @raj

mike: I can draft sizing + KMS notes by Tue noon.

raj: I'll run a quick sim once we have traces; aim to have an initial effort estimate by Tue EOD.

ellie: I'll own the renewal playbook and lead the Wed meeting. Preparing a short win/loss list for objections.

calendar-bot: Meeting created — OrionHealth pilot sync Wed 14:00 in #customer-success. Invite: alyssa, mike, raj, sara, ellie.

alyssa: Thanks team — i'll post traces when I have them. :thumbsup:
